title: Entity artifact
responsibility: Shows verified recorded result contents and a link to the original artifact.

inputs.name: EntityArtifact.cell
inputs.description: Required result cell with capture and read state. Missing capture or null media produces a gap; details require a verified read.

inputs.name: EntityArtifact.label
inputs.description: Required accessible group name, also naming the original-file link.

inputs.name: EntityArtifact.mediaBase
inputs.description: Required prefix joined with the capture’s media path for the original-file link.

inputs.name: EntityArtifact.lost
inputs.description: Optional flag, false by default. True turns an absent read into an unverified state instead of pending.

inputs.name: EntityArtifact.unit
inputs.description: Optional function identifier limiting direct-call rows; absent uses general recorded-case presentation.

outputs.name: EntityArtifact
outputs.description: Recorded cases plus expandable assertions, facts, steps, trace and other content after verification. Unknown assertions stay Not stated. Formatted values are shortened after 12,000 characters with a file-opening reminder. Raw JSON is inserted only while expanded. A stored capture always gets an original-file link, including while pending or unverified.
